sample_exam.text:
[경상중 2학년 2학기 기말 예시] 선택형 13문항(각 5점, 65점) + 서·논술형 5문항(각 7점, 35점)
범위: L7 Let's Enjoy Festivals, L8 Time Travel / 문법: 지각동사, so ~ that, 현재완료, -thing+형용사
※ 실제 기출이 아닙니다. 계획서에서 확인한 것은 배점·범위·문법이고, 문항 수·난이도·유형은 임의로 정했습니다. 지문은 새로 쓴 글입니다(교과서 본문 아님).

[선택형]

〈지문 A〉 1~5번
Every April, my town holds a flower festival. This year, the weather was so warm that the cherry trees bloomed early. When I arrived at the park, I heard people singing on a small stage. I also saw children dance in colorful costumes. My favorite part was the food street. I tried strawberry rice cakes, and they were so sweet that I ate three! Before I left, I bought a small pot of flowers for my mom. She has wanted one for a long time.

1. 윗글의 주제로 가장 알맞은 것은?
① the history of rice cakes
② how to sell flowers
③ why children like dancing
④ a day at a town flower festival
⑤ how to grow cherry trees

2. 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
① The festival is held every April.
② The writer ate only one rice cake.
③ The writer bought flowers for a friend.
④ The cherry trees bloomed late this year.
⑤ The writer danced on a small stage.

3. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
I heard people ______ on a small stage.
① sang
② to sing
③ singing
④ sung
⑤ to singing

4. 다음 빈칸에 차례로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
It was ______ cold ______ we stayed inside all day.
① as - as
② too - to
③ very - when
④ such - if
⑤ so - that

5. 윗글의 She has wanted one for a long time.의 현재완료와 용법이 같은 것은?
① I have just finished lunch.
② Have you ever seen a ghost?
③ I have lived here for five years.
④ She has lost her key.
⑤ He has been to Jeju twice.

〈지문 B〉 6~10번
Minho found an old watch in his grandfather's room. When he pressed the button, the room began to shake. Suddenly, he was standing in a busy market in the Joseon Dynasty. "I have never seen anything like this!" he shouted. People were wearing hanbok, and no one was using a phone. "I need something warm to eat," he thought, but his money was useless there. An old woman saw him shiver and gave him a bowl of soup. Minho still remembers her kindness.

6. 민호가 조선 시대 시장에 가게 된 직접적인 계기는?
① 낡은 시계의 버튼을 눌렀다.
② 할머니가 불렀다.
③ 시장에서 시계를 샀다.
④ 역사책을 읽다가 잠들었다.
⑤ 할아버지를 따라갔다.

7. 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
① An old woman gave Minho some soup.
② Minho bought soup with his money.
③ The room shook after he pressed the button.
④ People at the market were wearing hanbok.
⑤ Minho found the watch in his grandfather's room.

8. 어법상 올바른 문장은?
① There is interesting nothing here.
② I need warm something.
③ Do you have anything new?
④ She ate delicious something.
⑤ I want cold something.

9. 어법상 틀린 문장은?
① We watched them play soccer.
② I saw him cross the street.
③ He heard his name to call.
④ I felt something touch my arm.
⑤ She heard the baby cry.

10. 윗글의 useless의 뜻으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
① very expensive
② very old
③ not helpful or not able to be used
④ made of gold
⑤ easy to carry

〈공통〉

11. 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Which festival do you like better, the music festival or the food festival?
B: ______
A: Why?
B: Because I love trying new dishes.
① I went there by bus.
② The festival was last week.
③ I don't like dishes at all.
④ I prefer the music festival.
⑤ I like the food festival better.

12. 어법상 틀린 문장은?
① He has already finished his homework.
② She has lived here since 2020.
③ We have met him yesterday.
④ I have visited Busan twice.
⑤ They have never eaten tacos.

13. 〈지문 B〉의 제목으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
① A Kind Woman from the Past
② Money Is Everything
③ My Grandfather's Market
④ Phones in the Joseon Dynasty
⑤ How to Fix an Old Watch

[서·논술형]

14. 〈서술형〉 다음 우리말을 so ~ that을 사용하여 영어로 쓰시오.
그 영화는 너무 재미있어서 나는 그것을 두 번 보았다.

15. 〈서술형〉 지각동사 heard를 사용하여 다음 우리말을 영어로 쓰시오.
나는 그가 피아노를 치는 것을 들었다.

16. 〈서술형〉 현재완료와 since를 사용하여 두 문장을 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
I started to learn English in 2023. I still learn it.

17. 〈서술형〉 〈지문 A〉를 읽고 질문에 완전한 영어 문장으로 답하시오.
Why did the writer eat three rice cakes?

18. 〈논술형〉 시간 여행을 간다면 가고 싶은 시대와 이유를 2문장 이상, 20단어 이상의 영어로 쓰시오. 현재완료를 한 번 이상 사용할 것.

[정답]
1 ④ / 2 ① / 3 ③ / 4 ⑤ / 5 ③ / 6 ① / 7 ② / 8 ③ / 9 ③ (to call → called) / 10 ③ / 11 ⑤ / 12 ③ (yesterday는 현재완료와 함께 쓰지 않음) / 13 ①
14 The movie was so interesting that I watched it twice.
15 I heard him play the piano. (playing도 정답)
16 I have learned English since 2023.
17 The writer ate three rice cakes because they were so sweet.
18 예시 답안: I want to travel to the Joseon Dynasty. I have never seen a king in real life, so I want to meet King Sejong there.
채점(7점): 내용·이유 3점, 현재완료 사용 2점, 어법·단어 수 2점

[경일여중 2학년 2학기 기말 예시] 선택형 10문항(각 5점, 50점) + 서·논술형 5문항(각 10점, 50점)
범위: L4 Are You Money Smart?, L5 The City as a Canvas, L8 Time Travel / 문법: 관계대명사, 현재완료
※ 실제 기출이 아닙니다. 계획서에서 확인한 것은 배점·범위·문법이고, 문항 수·난이도·유형은 임의로 정했습니다. 범위는 표 배치로 읽어 확인이 필요합니다. 지문은 새로 쓴 글입니다(교과서 본문 아님).

[선택형]

〈지문 A〉 1~4번
Sora is a student who used to spend all her pocket money in a few days. One day, she found a notebook that her aunt gave her. She decided to write down everything that she bought. After a week, she saw that most of her money went to snacks. Now she saves 30 percent of her money first and spends the rest carefully. "I have saved 50,000 won since March," she says. "Money is a tool that can help me reach my goals."

1. 윗글의 요지로 가장 알맞은 것은?
① 공책은 비싼 것을 사야 한다.
② 지출을 기록하고 먼저 저축하는 습관이 돈 관리에 도움이 된다.
③ 돈을 많이 벌수록 행복하다.
④ 간식은 건강에 해롭다.
⑤ 용돈은 부모님이 관리해야 한다.

2. 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
① Sora spends more money now than before.
② Sora has saved 50,000 won since March.
③ Sora's aunt gave her the notebook.
④ Sora saves 30 percent of her money first.
⑤ Most of Sora's money went to snacks.

3. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
I know a girl ______ plays the cello.
① what
② whom
③ who
④ which
⑤ whose

4. 윗글의 a notebook that her aunt gave her의 that처럼 생략할 수 있는 것이 쓰인 문장은?
① The man who lives next door is kind.
② She is the girl who won the race.
③ This is the movie that I watched yesterday.
④ I have a dog that barks a lot.
⑤ The bus that goes to school is late.

〈지문 B〉 5~6번
Walk through some old neighborhoods and you will find walls that are full of color. Artists who paint these walls often work with the people who live nearby. For example, they may ask, "What does this street mean to you?" Then they turn the answers into pictures. Some people say street art is just graffiti. ______, when it is created with permission, it can bring visitors and make neighbors proud. The city itself becomes a canvas that everyone can enjoy for free.

5. 화가들이 그림을 그리기 전에 하는 일로 언급된 것은?
① 다른 도시의 벽화를 베낀다.
② 시청에 그림을 판다.
③ 주민에게 그 거리가 어떤 의미인지 묻는다.
④ 낡은 벽을 허문다.
⑤ 관광객에게 입장료를 받는다.

6. 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
① For example
② However
③ Also
④ So
⑤ First

〈지문 C〉 7~8번
Have you ever imagined visiting the past? I have always wanted to see the day when Hangeul was first shared with people. In those days, most people could not read Chinese characters, so writing was difficult for them. King Sejong, who cared about ordinary people, created an easy alphabet. If I could go back, I would thank him. Thanks to him, we have been able to read and write easily for centuries.

7. Why did King Sejong create an alphabet?
① Because Chinese characters were too easy.
② Because most people could not read Chinese characters.
③ Because he wanted to travel to the past.
④ Because people did not want to write.
⑤ Because foreigners asked him to.

8. 윗글의 ordinary와 뜻이 가장 가까운 것은?
① famous
② common
③ angry
④ foreign
⑤ rich

〈공통〉

9. 다음 빈칸에 차례로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
She ______ in Daegu ______ 2022.
① lives - for
② lived - since
③ has lived - since
④ is living - ago
⑤ has lived - for

10. 어법상 틀린 문장은?
① Have you ever been to Seoul?
② When have you arrived?
③ We have known him for years.
④ She has gone home.
⑤ I have read this book.

[서·논술형]

11. 〈서술형〉 관계대명사를 사용하여 두 문장을 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
I have a friend. She speaks three languages.

12. 〈서술형〉 관계대명사를 사용하여 두 문장을 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
This is the book. I bought it yesterday.

13. 〈서술형〉 〈지문 A〉의 내용을 2문장, 15단어 이상의 영어로 요약하시오.

14. 〈논술형〉 우리 동네 벽에 그리고 싶은 그림과 그 이유를 25단어 이상의 영어로 쓰시오. 관계대명사를 한 번 이상 사용할 것.

15. 〈논술형〉 역사 속 한 인물을 만난다면 누구를 만나 무엇을 묻고 싶은지 30단어 이상의 영어로 쓰시오. 현재완료를 한 번 이상 사용할 것.

[정답]
1 ② / 2 ① / 3 ③ / 4 ③ / 5 ③ / 6 ② / 7 ② / 8 ② / 9 ③ / 10 ② (when은 현재완료와 함께 쓰지 않음)
11 I have a friend who speaks three languages. (that도 정답)
12 This is the book (that/which) I bought yesterday.
13 예시 답안: Sora wrote down everything that she bought and saw that most of her money went to snacks. Now she saves 30 percent of her money first.
14 예시 답안: I want to paint a big tree that has many colorful leaves. Our neighborhood is very gray, so this picture would make people feel calm and happy every day.
15 예시 답안: I have always admired King Sejong, so I would like to meet him. I want to ask him how he created Hangeul and what made him care about ordinary people so much.
서·논술형 채점(10점): 13~15번은 내용 4점, 조건 3점, 어법·단어 수 3점

[경혜여중 2학년 2학기 기말 예시] 선택형 13문항(각 5점, 65점) + 서·논술형 5문항(각 7점, 35점)
범위: 6 How Things Work(일부), 7 A Taste of the World, 8 New Challenge Ahead / 문법: 접속사 if, 지각동사, so ~ that, 가주어 it, 상관접속사, 간접의문문
※ 실제 기출이 아닙니다. 계획서에서 확인한 것은 배점·범위·문법이고, 문항 수·난이도·유형은 임의로 정했습니다. 범위는 표 배치로 읽어 확인이 필요합니다. 지문은 새로 쓴 글입니다(교과서 본문 아님).

[선택형]

〈지문 A〉 1~4번
It is interesting to learn about food from other countries. In Korea, many families eat tteokguk on New Year's Day. In Mexico, people often make tamales together at Christmas. The work takes so long that the whole family has to help. In India, many people eat with their right hand, so it is polite to wash your hands before a meal. Although these foods are different, they have one thing in common: they bring people together.

1. 윗글에서 말하는 여러 나라 음식의 공통점은?
① 손으로 먹는다.
② 재료가 같다.
③ 만드는 시간이 짧다.
④ 사람들을 하나로 모은다.
⑤ 새해 첫날에만 먹는다.

2. 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
① In India, people never wash their hands before a meal.
② Many Korean families eat tteokguk at Christmas.
③ All of the foods are the same.
④ Mexican families often make tamales together at Christmas.
⑤ Tamales are very quick to make.

3. 윗글의 It is interesting to learn의 It과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
① It was on the desk.
② It is fun to swim in the sea.
③ It is my bag.
④ It is raining outside.
⑤ It is ten o'clock.

4. 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은?
The soup was so hot that I could not eat it.
① I could eat the soup because it was hot.
② The soup was too hot for me to eat.
③ The soup was not hot, so I ate it.
④ The soup was hot enough for me to eat.
⑤ The soup was as hot as I wanted.

〈지문 B〉 5~9번
Last year, I joined the school swimming club. At first, I was not only afraid of water but also shy around new people. My coach asked me what I wanted to achieve. I told her that I wanted to swim across the pool without stopping. "If you practice every day, you will do it," she said. For months, I practiced hard. One day, I heard my friends cheer as I touched the wall. I did it! Now I know that both courage and patience are important.

5. 윗글의 제목으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
① The Rules of Swimming Races
② My Challenge in the Pool
③ Why Swimming Clubs Are Expensive
④ How to Choose a Swimsuit
⑤ My Coach's Swimming Career

6. 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
① The coach told the writer to stop practicing.
② The writer wanted to swim across the pool without stopping.
③ At first, the writer was afraid of water.
④ The writer joined the swimming club last year.
⑤ The writer's friends cheered for the writer.

7. 다음 빈칸에 차례로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
She is ______ kind ______ smart.
① both - or
② neither - and
③ so - as
④ not only - but also
⑤ either - nor

8. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Do you know ______?
① where lives he
② does he live where
③ he lives where
④ where does he live
⑤ where he lives

9. 어법상 틀린 문장은?
① If she will come tomorrow, I will be happy.
② If you are tired, you can rest.
③ If it rains, we will stay home.
④ We will go out if it stops snowing.
⑤ If you study hard, you will pass the test.

〈지문 C〉 10~12번
Have you ever wondered how a thermos keeps soup hot? A thermos has two walls with almost no air between them. This empty space is called a vacuum. Heat cannot travel easily through a vacuum. If you pour hot soup into a thermos and close the lid, the soup stays hot for hours. The same bottle can also keep cold drinks cold.

10. 보온병이 수프를 뜨겁게 유지하는 이유로 알맞은 것은?
① 벽이 아주 얇아서
② 수프가 원래 식지 않아서
③ 불이 들어 있어서
④ 뚜껑이 없어서
⑤ 두 벽 사이의 진공으로 열이 잘 이동하지 못해서

11. 윗글의 vacuum의 뜻으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
① a thick wall
② a cold room
③ a space with almost no air
④ a kind of lid
⑤ a very hot drink

12. 윗글의 내용상 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A thermos can keep drinks ______.
① neither hot nor cold
② dirty
③ only cold
④ either hot or cold
⑤ only hot

〈공통〉

13. 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Have you ever tried Mexican food?
B: ______ I had tacos last weekend.
A: How were they?
B: They were so good that I want to eat them again.
① No, I haven't.
② No, I can't.
③ Yes, I am.
④ Yes, I have.
⑤ Yes, I will.

[서·논술형]

14. 〈서술형〉 가주어 It을 사용하여 문장을 다시 쓰시오.
To learn a new language is hard.

15. 〈서술형〉 so ~ that을 사용하여 다음 우리말을 영어로 쓰시오.
그 상자는 너무 무거워서 나는 그것을 들 수 없었다.

16. 〈서술형〉 두 문장을 간접의문문을 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
Can you tell me? Where is the library?

17. 〈서술형〉 not only ~ but also를 사용하여 두 문장을 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
Minho likes soccer. Minho likes baseball, too.

18. 〈논술형〉 외국인 친구에게 소개하고 싶은 한국 음식과 그 이유를 20단어 이상의 영어로 쓰시오. 가주어 It을 한 번 이상 사용할 것.

[정답]
1 ④ / 2 ④ / 3 ② / 4 ② / 5 ② / 6 ① / 7 ④ / 8 ⑤ / 9 ① (will come → comes) / 10 ⑤ / 11 ③ / 12 ④ / 13 ④
14 It is hard to learn a new language.
15 The box was so heavy that I could not lift it.
16 Can you tell me where the library is?
17 Minho likes not only soccer but also baseball.
18 예시 답안: I want to introduce bibimbap to my foreign friend. It is easy to enjoy this food because it has many vegetables and a delicious sauce.
채점(7점): 내용·이유 3점, 가주어 사용 2점, 어법·단어 수 2점

[대구중 2학년 2학기 기말 예시] 선택형 10문항(각 5점, 50점) + 서·논술형 5문항(각 10점, 50점)
범위: Unit 3 Making Our School Better, Unit 4 Small Choices, Big Changes (L5~8) / 계획서에서 확인된 문법: as ~ as (그 밖의 문법은 확인되지 않아 넣지 않음)
※ 실제 기출이 아닙니다. 계획서에서 확인한 것은 배점·범위·문법이고, 문항 수·난이도·유형은 임의로 정했습니다. 지문은 새로 쓴 글입니다(교과서 본문 아님).

[선택형]

〈지문 A〉 1~4번
Last spring, our student council asked, "How can we make our school better?" Many students said the cafeteria was as noisy as a train station. Others said too much food was thrown away. So the council started a quiet lunch week and a no-leftovers challenge. Students who finished their meals got a sticker. After a month, the food waste was only half as much as before. Small ideas from students made a big change.

1. 윗글의 주제로 가장 알맞은 것은?
① why train stations are noisy
② how students improved their school cafeteria
③ how to cook healthy food
④ how to collect stickers
⑤ why students dislike lunch

2. 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
① The council started a no-leftovers challenge.
② Many students thought the cafeteria was noisy.
③ The food waste doubled after a month.
④ Students who finished their meals got a sticker.
⑤ The student council asked students for ideas.

3. 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은?
My bag is not as heavy as yours.
① My bag is as heavy as yours.
② My bag is heavier than yours.
③ My bag is the heaviest of all.
④ Your bag is not heavy at all.
⑤ Your bag is heavier than mine.

4. 윗글의 내용상 한 달 뒤 음식물 쓰레기의 양은?
① 전혀 없었다.
② 전의 세 배였다.
③ 전의 절반이었다.
④ 전의 두 배였다.
⑤ 전과 같았다.

〈지문 B〉 5~8번
Every choice seems small. Carrying a reusable bottle does not look like much. But if one person avoids one plastic bottle a day, that means 365 fewer bottles a year. If all 500 students in a school do the same, the number becomes ______. ( A ), one person cannot solve every problem. But small choices, when many people make them, can be as powerful as a new law.

5. 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 수로 알맞은 것은?
① 865
② 1,825
③ 18,250
④ 182,500
⑤ 1,825,000

6. 윗글의 요지로 가장 알맞은 것은?
① 학생은 물을 많이 마셔야 한다.
② 많은 사람이 함께하는 작은 선택이 큰 변화를 만든다.
③ 법은 빨리 바꿀수록 좋다.
④ 플라스틱 병은 값이 싸다.
⑤ 한 사람이 모든 문제를 해결할 수 있다.

7. 윗글의 ( A )에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
① First of all
② Of course
③ As a result
④ For example
⑤ In the same way

8. 윗글의 reusable의 뜻으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
① very heavy
② used only once
③ easy to break
④ able to be used again
⑤ made of paper

〈공통〉

9. 어법상 틀린 문장은?
① The test was not as hard as I thought.
② My room is as clean than yours.
③ Tom is as tall as his father.
④ This book is not as long as that one.
⑤ She runs as fast as her brother.

10. 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: What do you think we should do to make our classroom better?
B: ______
A: Good idea. It will make the room much cleaner.
① I don't know where you live.
② We had math class this morning.
③ I was late for class today.
④ My classroom is on the third floor.
⑤ I think we should clean it together every Friday.

[서·논술형]

11. 〈서술형〉 as ~ as를 사용하여 다음 우리말을 영어로 쓰시오.
이 교실은 저 교실만큼 넓다.

12. 〈서술형〉 not as ~ as를 사용하여 같은 뜻의 문장으로 쓰시오.
Minsu is taller than Jiho. → Jiho ______

13. 〈서술형〉 〈지문 A〉에서 학생회가 시작한 일 두 가지를 완전한 영어 문장으로 쓰시오.

14. 〈논술형〉 우리 학교에 새로 생기면 좋을 행사를 하나 주장하는 글을 30단어 이상의 영어로 쓰시오. 이유를 두 가지 쓸 것.

15. 〈논술형〉 환경을 위해 친구들에게 제안하고 싶은 작은 실천을 25단어 이상의 영어로 쓰시오. as ~ as를 한 번 이상 사용할 것.

[정답]
1 ② / 2 ③ / 3 ⑤ / 4 ③ / 5 ④ (365 × 500) / 6 ② / 7 ② / 8 ④ / 9 ② (than → as) / 10 ⑤
11 This classroom is as large as that classroom. (wide, that one도 정답)
12 Jiho is not as tall as Minsu.
13 The council started a quiet lunch week. It also started a no-leftovers challenge.
14 예시 답안: I think our school should hold a book festival. First, students can find new books they like. Second, they can share their favorite stories and become closer to one another.
15 예시 답안: Let's bring our own cups to school. Using a cup every day is as easy as using a paper cup, and it can reduce a lot of trash.
서·논술형 채점(10점): 13번은 한 가지당 5점 / 14·15번은 내용 4점, 조건 3점, 어법·단어 수 3점

[대명중 2학년 2학기 기말 예시] 선택형 10문항(각 5점, 50점) + 서술형 5문항(각 10점, 50점)
범위: Unit 3 To Be Remembered, Unit 4 I See You Do It! / 문법: before/after, 수동태, 조건 if, 가주어 It ~ to V, 간접의문문, 지각동사, 현재·과거분사
※ 실제 기출이 아닙니다. 계획서에서 확인한 것은 배점·범위·문법이고, 문항 수·난이도·유형은 임의로 정했습니다. 지문은 새로 쓴 글입니다(교과서 본문 아님).

[선택형]

〈지문 A〉 1~4번
Before we visited Gyeongju, our teacher told us to read about Bulguksa. The temple was built more than 1,200 years ago, during the Silla Dynasty. After we arrived, we walked up to its famous stone stairs and looked at Dabotap, a stone pagoda. Dabotap can be seen on the Korean 10-won coin! It is important to protect places like this. If we take care of them, people in the future will also be able to enjoy them.

1. 윗글의 주제로 가장 알맞은 것은?
① the life of a Silla king
② how to climb stone stairs
③ how to make a coin
④ the price of a school trip
⑤ a visit to Bulguksa and the need to protect it

2. 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
① Bulguksa was built during the Silla Dynasty.
② Dabotap is a stone pagoda.
③ Dabotap can be seen on the 10-won coin.
④ Bulguksa was built about 100 years ago.
⑤ The teacher told the students to read about Bulguksa.

3. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The temple ______ more than 1,200 years ago.
① has built
② is building
③ built
④ was built
⑤ builds

4. 윗글의 It is important to protect의 It과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
① It was Monday yesterday.
② It is my new coin.
③ It is easy to make friends.
④ It is very cold today.
⑤ It is in the box.

〈지문 B〉 5~8번
Do you know how much plastic ends up in the sea? Last Saturday, I joined a beach cleanup in Busan. I saw volunteers pick up broken bottles and plastic bags. A smiling woman showed us the collected trash. "If we use less plastic, the sea will be cleaner," she said. After we finished, the beach looked completely different. Now I always carry my own bag before I go shopping.

5. 글쓴이가 지난 토요일에 한 일은?
① 시장에서 가방을 팔았다.
② 부산으로 이사했다.
③ 해변 정화 활동에 참여했다.
④ 바다에서 수영을 했다.
⑤ 플라스틱 공장을 방문했다.

6. 윗글의 smiling woman, broken bottles에서 smiling, broken의 쓰임을 바르게 설명한 것은?
① 둘 다 부사이다.
② smiling은 '미소 지어진', broken은 '깨고 있는'이라는 뜻이다.
③ 둘 다 동사의 과거형이다.
④ 둘 다 명사이다.
⑤ smiling은 '미소 짓는', broken은 '깨진'이라는 뜻으로 명사를 꾸민다.

7. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
I saw volunteers ______ up bottles on the beach.
① picked
② to picking
③ picks
④ to pick
⑤ pick

8. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Do you know ______?
① how much plastic ends up in the sea
② plastic how much ends up in the sea
③ how plastic much ends up in the sea
④ how much ends plastic up in the sea
⑤ how much plastic does end up in the sea it

〈공통〉

[정답]
1 ⑤ / 2 ④ / 3 ④ / 4 ③ / 5 ③ / 6 ⑤ / 7 ⑤ / 8 ① / 9 ④ (will study → study) / 10 ③ (sang → sung)

서술형 채점(10점): 11~13번은 어순·어법 기준 / 14·15번은 내용 4점, 조건 3점, 어법·단어 수 3점

[협성경복중 2학년 2학기 기말 예시] 선택형 12문항(각 5점, 60점) + 서·논술형 5문항(각 8점, 40점)
범위: L7 Let's Enjoy Festivals, L8 Time Travel / 의사소통: 선호와 이유 묻고 답하기 / 문법: 지각동사, so ~ that, 현재완료, -thing+형용사 (같은 단원명을 쓰는 경상중 계획서 기준이라 확인 필요)
※ 실제 기출이 아닙니다. 계획서에서 확인한 것은 배점·범위이고, 문항 수·난이도·유형은 임의로 정했습니다. 지문은 새로 쓴 글입니다(교과서 본문 아님).

[선택형]

〈지문 A〉 1~6번
People around the world celebrate the seasons with festivals. In Thailand, people throw water at each other during Songkran in April. The water feels so cool that nobody minds getting wet. In July, visitors to Boryeong, Korea, play in soft mud at a mud festival. In February, Sapporo, Japan, becomes a winter wonderland. You can see artists making huge statues out of snow. Which festival would you like to visit? I prefer Songkran because I love water fights.

② Why Mud Is Good for Skin
③ Festivals for Every Season
④ The History of Thailand
⑤ My Trip to Japan

2. 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
① Artists make statues out of snow.
② Songkran takes place in April.
③ Sapporo has a winter festival in February.
④ The mud festival in Boryeong takes place in July.
⑤ The writer prefers the festival in Sapporo.

① Sapporo
② Bangkok
③ Boryeong
④ Seoul
⑤ Thailand

① made
② to making
③ making
④ to make
⑤ makes

5. 다음 문장의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
The music was so loud that I couldn't hear you.

③ 음악이 너무 커서 나는 네 말을 들을 수 없었다.
④ 나는 음악을 듣고 싶지 않았다.
⑤ 음악이 크지 않아서 나는 네 말을 들었다.

③ Which season do you prefer, summer or winter?

〈지문 B〉 7~10번
I have always wondered what the future will look like. In my dream last night, I traveled to the year 2090. Flying buses filled the sky. A robot offered me something cold to drink. "Have you ever tried this?" it asked. It tasted so strange that I laughed. Then I saw an old man who looked like me. "Study hard and stay kind," he said. When I woke up, I wrote down everything.

[정답]
1 ③ / 2 ⑤ / 3 ③ / 4 ③ / 5 ③ / 6 ③ / 7 ① / 8 ③ (something special이 맞음) / 9 ② / 10 ① / 11 ④ (last year는 현재완료와 함께 쓰지 않음) / 12 ④
